document.executive_summary: All four robot cell packages pass both client gates, so WO-04 reduces to measured energy on the shared acceptance-batch basis. The verified ladder is P1 6 kWh, P3 14, P2 40, P4 67, giving gaps of +8, +34 and +61 kWh over the minimum. The energy-first policy selects P1, 8 kWh (2.33x) below runner-up P3. Defect margins invert that picture: P1 and P3 carry 1/5 defects with four defects of headroom, while P2 and P4 sit at the 5/5 ceiling where any added defect disqualifies. sections.body: The policy qualifies any package with quality at least 80 and a raw defect count at most 5, then minimizes energy, using candidate ID only to break ties. Against the trusted table: quality reads P4 100, P1 98, P3 89, P2 86, all above 80; defects read P1 1, P3 1, P2 5, P4 5, all within the ceiling. All four qualify, so nothing is rejected, and the tie-break never engages because the energy readings are distinct. The decision therefore rests entirely on the energy column; the eligibility test only sets the field.

sections.body: Measured energy orders the field P1 6 < P3 14 < P2 40 < P4 67 kWh. The winning margin over P3 is 8 kWh; P3 to P2 adds 26; P2 to P4 adds 27. Relative to P1, P3 costs 2.33x, P2 6.67x and P4 11.17x the minimum. Spacing drives sensitivity: P3 is close enough that a large measurement error or a defect finding could change the outcome, whereas P2 and P4 trail by 34 and 61 kWh and are unreachable under any admissible re-measurement. All readings share one acceptance batch, output and load, so no cross-basis correction applies.

sections.body: Defect positions invert the intuitive quality story. P1 (quality 98, 1/5) and P3 (89, 1/5) each keep four defects of headroom; P2 (86, 5/5) and P4 (100, 5/5) sit exactly at the ceiling, so a single added defect disqualifies them. The winner is therefore the most robust candidate on both axes at once. The natural fallback is P3 at 14 kWh, equally robust on defects; it takes the win only if P1 is disqualified by new defect findings or an invalidated measurement.
